Summary

  • Geometry is sound: verify-track OK, audit all six checks within baseline (0 floating, 0 severe clip, 0 buried/unsupported). 72 frames captured, 0 failures.
  • The visual identity is where it misses the brief: the "blank, unglazed, unlit" marina shells render as glazed, windowed, partly lit towers; the sky is saturated ultramarine with no coastal haze; fog does not reach the sky or far dressing; night has no lamps yet glowing light pools.

Ranked defects (suggested fixes — NOT applied)

1. Marina "shells" are glazed, windowed and partly lit — brief violation. high seen p00 p33 p67 p83, dusk/night
Frames: p67 orbit/eye/trackside, p83 orbit. Mechanism: cityFront (scenery/korea.js:340, :402) and tower (:403, :411) go through the generic building() path, which always emits window panes — 20 % lit share, dark glass otherwise (js/track/scenery/city.js:68-117, cityFront defaults city.js:719-731); tower() adds glass cylinders [0.40,0.52,0.64] (city.js:831-835) and pyramid/cap tops. Floors appear as stacked slabs with sky showing between them (p67 trackside). Brief: "blank unglazed shells… blank, unlit, unfinished" (docs/tracks/korea.md §6). Fix: replace the two cityFront rows and the two tower calls with plain place()/modelGroup concrete boxes (SHELL palette, as the required korea-marina-shells group already does at :348-377), or add a windowless option to building() (engine change → parent).
2. Sky is saturated ultramarine to the horizon; no coastal haze. high all day frames
Brief: "flat coastal light, high haze, low contrast". Def pal zenith (.28,.42,.60)/horizon (.66,.68,.68) (js/circuits/korea.js:52-53) is a muted grey-blue, but renders deep blue with a hard horizon line at every position. Cause not isolated (guess: sky gradient/exposure path ignores palette horizon, or sun/zenith weighting in js/lighting/atmosphere.js). Fix: parent to check the sky shader mapping; circuit-side, raise fogDensity (korea.js:59) only helps ground.
3. Fog and far dressing disagree. medium fog frames
In fog the ground and road haze but sky stays ultramarine and glazed towers (p33 top-left, p83 centre) remain crisp. Likely the sky and far backdrop aren't fogged to the same colour (guess); fogColor (.64,.66,.66) (korea.js:58) is not what the sky shows.
4. Hard-edged tan plates read as floating flat wedges. medium p17 p33 p83
Large groundPatch LOT/FILL footprints (scenery/korea.js:215-216 132 m/210 m out, :148, :281) and runoffApron (:222-223, :263-264, :427-428; identity.js:255-282 box slabs) have crisp polygon edges and render tan, not the specified grey APRON (.40,.41,.42). The frames show a sharp wedge over the grass at p33 left and p83 lower-left. Fix: soften/blend colour toward SALT, reduce patch footprints near the verge, or fall back to the grey APRON constant (verify actual colours with __apex.scene() first).
5. Night: black sky, lamp-less light pools, lit shell windows. medium night/dusk frames
night:false and lamp:"none" (korea.js:39,76) yet warm light pools sit on the verge (p17/p33/p83 night) with no visible source; shell windows glow amber (see #1). Per survey-track docs, non-night circuits get night sky/fog only; this is expected but visually inconsistent. Fix: either author a few floodlight masts / accept pools as the engine's generic fill, or document as "no night scenery".
6. Grass reads vivid green, not salt-bleached. low
SALT (.47,.49,.39) in scenery and pal.grass (korea.js:60) render as bright lawn green, especially left of the road at p00/p17, against the "thin, bleached" brief. Fix: lower saturation of pal.grass; reduce the base every(64) density bias (scenery/korea.js:85-97).
7. Storm / rain grounds are near-black. low rain/storm p17 p33
After the #1979 daytime-rain fix, sky is grey, but grass/fill go almost black, widening ground-to-sky contrast. Possibly the wet-ground darkening multiplier on low-albedo palette (guess).
8. Geometry/data nits. low
Built length 5555 m vs 5613/5615 (−1.0 %); constant 16 m width with no zones; startFrac unverified; sectors are thirds rather than FIA (korea.js:72); docs/tracks/korea.md says "modern" while def is "green" (korea.js:46). Uncertain whether the 0.0 elevation matches reality (the brief says reclaimed flat land).
